title: Steel Sectional (2002 / 2012 / 2022)
shortDesc: Extra heavy-duty deep-ribbed 20-ga steel sectional doors, single to triple layer, up to 26' wide.
description:
Amarr's Steel Sectional line (2002 single-layer, 2012 double-layer, 2022 triple-layer) is built for extra heavy-duty commercial and industrial use. Deep-ribbed 20-gauge steel sections can be factory- or field-modified, with CFC-free polystyrene insulation and nylon or steel backers on the insulated models.

With tested U-factors down to 0.341, sizes up to 26'2" wide, Rapid Install Vertical Lift, SuperFlex impact compatibility, and a 10-year limited warranty, it's a versatile workhorse for warehouses and loading docks.

title: Aluminum Full-View Sectional
shortDesc: Modern, industrial-styled aluminum-and-glass doors for retail, office, education, and entertainment venues.
description:
Amarr's Aluminum Sectional doors bring a modern, industrial aesthetic to commercial storefronts. Expansive glass in durable aluminum frames suits retail, office, education, and entertainment spaces that want light and visibility.

A range of glass and finish options lets you tailor the look while keeping the corrosion resistance and low maintenance of aluminum.

title: Rolling Slat & Grille
shortDesc: Roll-up service doors and security grilles for security, insulation, and fire protection.
description:
Amarr's Rolling Slat & Grille doors are coiling roll-up doors and security grilles designed to meet a wide range of commercial needs — security, insulation, fire protection, and more.

Available in multiple slat profiles and grille styles, they're a durable, space-saving solution for storefronts, parking structures, warehouses, and service counters.

title: Rolling Sheet
shortDesc: Comprehensive roll-up line for commercial dock/drive-through and self-storage applications.
description:
Amarr's Rolling Sheet doors cover a comprehensive range of coiling roll-up applications, from commercial dock and drive-through openings to self-storage facility doors.

Built for durability and efficient use of headroom, they're a reliable, cost-effective choice for high-volume storage and commercial sites.
